note: Live adapter resolves the current official Probation & Parole Warranted Offenders PDF from the Portsmouth crime page and only returns names parsed from that official publication.
Live adapter parses the Newport News Police Department Active Warrants dashboard, which publishes names, DOB, issue date and warrant charge.
Norfolk publishes a daily Active Warrants open-data dataset. Adapter remains disabled until its machine-readable endpoint is runtime-verified.
Hampton Police publishes an official Wanted List. Adapter remains disabled until the live page structure is safely parsed and runtime-verified.
Suffolk directs outstanding-warrant inquiries to Suffolk Police and publishes periodic Most Wanted lists, but no full current name-level warrant feed has been verified.
Virginia Beach provides official warrant and magistrate contact information, but no full public active-warrant name feed has been verified.
The official city page directs outstanding-warrant inquiries to the Chesapeake Warrant Unit. No public name-level feed is enabled, so the app does not infer names.
